newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy CPI raises hope of rate cut-Treasury's Pinzo.
newsitem.headline: Italy CPI raises hope of rate cut-Treasury's Pinzo.

text.p: Preliminary data pointing to a sharp fall in April inflation raises hopes for an interest rate cut, Treasury undersecretary Roberto Pinza told reporters.

Preliminary data from six Italian cities published on Monday indicated inflation falling to 1.8 percent year-on-year in April from 2.2 percent in March. A further five cities are due to release their inflation figures later on Tuesday.
"Certainly the violent fall in the inflation rate makes one hope for something from interest rates," Pinza said at a conference, adding it was a matter for the Bank of Italy to decide.
The Bank of Italy, which is independent of government control, cut the discount rate to 6.75 percent in January -- the third cut in seven months.
